Commentary.Commentary: West Indies started off well but kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Roston Chase was the only one who looked comfortable out there but he didn't get enough support from the other end. Holder then tried to hang around there but Pakistan ran through the lower middle order which means the visitors now lead by 129 runs. We still have almost 4 sessions left in the game but one would wonder if we will get a result on this flat deck. Let's see if we get a dramatic end to the series. Join us in a while for Pakistan's reply...

So, Pakistan have taken just a little over an hour to wrap up the hosts. It was the Mohammad Abbas show today. He was lethal on what has been a flat surface. Mohammad Amir drew first blood this morning and then it was all about Abbas. He took a 5-fer, his maiden in Tests, to give Pakistan the upper hand. Yasir Shah bowled long spells and has three wickets to his name.

OUT! MAIDEN TEST 5-FER FOR MOHAMMAD ABBAS! On the flattest of surfaces, this young man has produced a terrific bowling performance. He's greeted with a standing ovation from every corner of the stadium as he walks back with the match ball. Fuller length ball shaping back in, Shannon Gabriel looks to flick but it goes off his pads, at least so it seems. Babar Azam at short leg takes a sharp catch and Pakistan appeal. The umpire gives it out. There did appear to be two sounds, but Gabriel has decided to review it. The replays show there was a faint edge and the on-field call will stay. Hasan Ali knows his side has got its man, so he walks behind the umpire, raises his finger himself in a joking manner. The visitors are all smiles as WEST INDIES HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 247!
Shannon Gabriel is caught at short leg and the umpire has given him out. He opts for the review. Maybe, he didn't play at it. Let's wait and find out...
Quite full but around off, Gabriel jams it out.
Full and on the stumps, worked away to mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length once more, shoots off the deck a bit and holds its line, Holder walks across a step to defend but is beaten and the ball goes off his thigh pad behind towards the slip cordon.
Length delivery around off, Holder stays inside the crease and keeps it out.
Full and moving back in from around off, Jason Holder takes a big stride forward and drives it straight back to the bowler.
Gets down and sweeps it fine down the leg side to keep strike.
Floats it up around leg, Holder looks to reverse sweep but Azhar Ali at point makes a fine stop.
FOUR! Good shot! Holder gets down on one knee and brings out the sweep. Makes lovely connection as the ball goes through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A bit quicker through the air around middle and leg, Holder looks to sweep it away but misses and is hit on the pads.
Loopy around leg, Holder prods forward to keep it out.
Tossed up outside leg, Holder reverse sweeps it through covers. The ball goes in the deep but they don't run.
Excellent delivery to end the over. Really bends his back, hurls it just around off and beats the outside edge of Shannon Gabriel's bat. Another excellent over from Abbas comes to an end.
Slower one from Abbas, Gabriel is years early into the shot. The ball comes much later as he hangs his bat out to block.
Back of a length on middle and leg, coming in, Gabriel rises and works it down on the track on the leg side.

Welcomes Gabriel with a fiery yorker, on middle and off, Gabriel just about manages to bring his bat down to dig it out. Gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball rolls away on the off side. That was mighty close.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in.
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! Another wicket for Mohammad Abbas, his fourth of the innings. This is exceptional bowling. He fires it full and on leg, Joseph looks to flick it across but can't put any bat on it. It goes off the pad and rattles the timber. Too, too good. The tailender had no chance to dig it out, the Windies are just a wicket away from being bowled out.

Slower short ball angling down, Holder swivels across and pulls it fine down the leg side. Takes the first one and wants the second, but Hasan Ali at fine leg does exceptionally well. Gets to the ball quickly and the keeps the batsmen to just one.
Nearly a wicket! Tossed up around middle, it's very full, Joseph looks to clear his front leg and go big across the line but gets an inside edge past the leg pole to short fine leg.
Loopy delivery on off, turning away. AJ doesn't offer any stroke.
Floated ball around middle and off, Joseph defends it down on the pitch.
Flatter one around off, from over the wicket, Joseph punches it towards covers.
Fuller around the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Gets behind it and defends it off the back foot.
Short ball, angling in, Alzarri ducks under it.
Bowls a cutter, coming in with the angle, Joseph looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Clearly it was going down leg.
Fuller and outside off, Joseph drives it towards mid off.
Alzarri Joseph is the next man in. He's going to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Edged and taken! Abbas has two in two now! Goes around the wicket and serves a full length delivery outside off, Bishoo with no foot movement looks to poke at it. Gets an outside edge and Younis Khan at second slip crouches low to take a very good one-handed catch to his left. They appeal but the umpire cut short their celebration for a while as he wants see if the catch is taken cleanly or not. First replay was enough for the TV umpire to give the call. Pakistan right on the money here.
Bishoo has been caught at second slip by Younis Khan. The umpire's want to see if he has taken it cleanly. The soft signal is OUT!
Devendra Bishoo walks out to the middle.

OUT! Abbas strikes and he removes the dangerous Chase! What a delivery! Comes steaming in and fires a perfect yorker which tails back in on middle and leg. Chase looks to flick it across the line but is undone by the sheer pace on it. The ball hits his pads and deflects onto the stumps. Roston Chase departs after a gritty innings.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball on off, it bounces off the deck as Chase ducks under it.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Loops it up outside leg, Holder pads it away on the leg side.
Tossed up on middle and leg, milked down to long on for a single.
On middle and leg, Chase works it away on the on side.
Tossed up around middle, eased down to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Holder defends it down.
Outside leg, Holder comes forward and pads it away.
Good length on middle, pushed towards mid off.
Short and outside off, Chase tries to pull it away but then at the last moment drops his wrists to let that carry to the keeper.
Good length, served outside off, Chase dabs it with an angled bat towards the point fielder.
Sprays down the leg side, Chase looks to flick but fails to put it away.
On a length and just around off, tapped towards the point fielder.
Angles in a length ball on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Mohammad Abbas is into the bowling attack now.
Bowls the wrong 'un, Jason covers the sticks and defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drops it outside leg, it spins in with bounce, holder trusts the bounce to let it be.
Very full around middle, Jason prods forward in defense.
Touch short and spinning in from outside leg, Holder flicks it a bit uppishly towards mid on.
Spinning into the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Holder defends it down the track.
FOUR! Lovely flow of the bat! Pitches it up outside off, Jason Holder clears his front leg and lofts it cleanly down the ground for a one bounce boundary.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Holder pushes it towards the point fielder.
Fuller and angling away, Holder pokes inside the line only to get beaten.
Fuller and sprayed a bit wide outside off, Jason lunges forward and defends it down solidly.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Chase pulls it with control in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Short leg is pushed back to square leg, a little deep.
Similar delivery, outside leg, spins in, Holder looks to keep it out off the front foot but misses and is hit on the pads. LBW can't be given for obvious reason.

Ripper! Gives it a nice loop, pitches it outside leg, it turns in with sharp bounce. Holder takes a long stride forward but then leaves it alone. The ball whizzes past the off stump. That was mighty close.
Tossed up on leg, spins back in, Holder goes deep in his crease and defends it towards short leg.
Once again outside leg, Holder lunges forward and defends it down gently.
Tosses it outside leg, it turns in, Holder off the back foot keeps it out on the pitch.
Loopy and outside leg, Chase plays it off his pads to wide mid on for a single.
Bouncer, nicely directed, Holder ducks to evade it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A touch short around off, Chase gets across the stumps and pulls it behind square leg for one.
Angles across a length delivery outside off, Roston allows it through to the keeper.
Pitches it full and on off, Chase brings his bat close to the front pad in defense.
Angles across a length ball on off, Chase sticks back and punches it to the off side.
Slower ball on off, Holder gets back and punches it towards mid on.
Floated one outside off, left alone.
Slightly quicker and flatter on off, defended from the crease by Jason.
Tossed up and outside off, Holder has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full floated ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Deep backward square leg in place.
FOUR! A freebie from Yasir, serves a low full toss around leg, Holder goes down on one knee, not an easy job for a tall man as he sweeps it neatly to the long leg fence for a boundary.
Well outside off, comfortably away from the batsman, Chase has no trouble leaving that.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Lands this on a length once more, outside off, played to point for no run.
Play and a miss from Jason Holder. Mohammad Amir gets it to shape away from around off, on a length as well, Holder plays away from his body but is beaten past the outside edge.
Angling across on a length, Jason Holder goes deep inside his crease and defends it down on the track.
Slips it on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for an easy single.
Some decent flight on this occasion, Roston drives it to deep mid off for a single.
Full around off, pushed back down the track for nothing.

Not out! Yasir drops this a bit short outside off, Chase punches this through towards sweeper cover and comes back for the second. There is a throw at the bowler's end from Azhar Ali and he gets a direct hit. Holder slides his bat in, looks comfortably safe but the umpire still wants to check it upstairs. Replays show he's fine.
A run out appeal against Jason Holder is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Loops this up outside off, driven straight to the extra cover fielder.
Spinning away from around off, on a length, Chase goes back and pushes it along the ground past the vacant silly point position.
Yasir starts off with a full toss around off, Holder comes forward and drives it back down towards mid off for a single. The fielder is positioned quite deep.
Yasir Shah will bowl from the other end.
Back of a length outside off, Chase rises on his toes and punches it a bit square on the off side off the back foot.
He does! Welcomes Roston Chase back with a short one, but it's wide outside off, he sways away from the ball and lets it be.

Roston Chase walks in next. He was struck on the forearm yesterday by a Mohammad Amir bouncer and left the field in pain. It appears he is fine and will resume. Once again it's Amir to bowl. Will he go short again to him?

OUT! The change of angle has worked for Mohammad Amir. This is just what the visitors would have wanted. Comes from around the wicket and bangs in a short of a length delivery outside off, Shane Dowrich with minimal foot movement attempts to push it away from his body once more. Gets an inside edge and drags it back onto the stumps. A wicket in the very first over of the day, West Indies in a bit of trouble.
Bangs in a short one to Shane, it's ducked and evaded.
Slants across on a good length, just outside off, this time Dowrich uses his feet this time and reaches out for the ball. Pushes it away once more to the covers.
Good length delivery swinging away, on a good length outside off, Shane Dowrich stands his ground and pushes it away in front of covers as he plays away from his body.

We are all set to get the ball rolling on the fourth day. It's nice and warm, the sun is shining and it's a beautiful day for Test cricket. The Pakistan side is in a huddle by the rope as Shane Dowrich and Jason Holder stride out to the middle. Mohammad Amir will take the ball first up. Two slips and a gully in place. Let's go...

For Pakistan, it was a tiring day, with not a lot of assistance for the fast bowlers. Yasir Shah was getting some spin but it was on the slower side so the batsmen could adjust and change their shots at the right time. We could be in for something similar today. Can Pakistan get a few early wickets or will the hosts reduce the deficit further?

Hello and welcome to the 4th day of the Test match between West Indies and Pakistan. The home side finished the third day on 218/5, Dowrich remained unbeaten on 20 and Holder not out on 11. But it was Roston Chase, the man for West Indies who steadied the ship with a well played 60 before getting struck on the forearm while playing a pull shot to Amir's short ball and went off retired hurt. Although, the good news is that scans have showed it's just a bruise and he's ready to bat today.
... DAY 4, MORNING SESSION ...

A fairly decent session for West Indies. However, they'd be disappointed that they lost Roston Chase to injury. Vishaul Singh was the only wicket to fall in the entire session who fell prey to Mohammad Abbas. Shane Dowrich and Jason Holder came in and saw the remainder of the day without incurring any further damage. The plan tomorrow for the hosts would be to bat for as long as possible and try for a result on the final day. We won't have an early start tomorrow, so play will begin at the original start time, which is 1000 local. See you folks then!

Lovely ball to finish things off! Yasir Shah bowls it quicker through the air around middle, the ball turns away sharply with some extra bounce. Jason Holder almost falls in the trap to poke it but is lucky not to nick one behind. Hands on head for Yasir as the players shake hands. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Floats it up around off, defended into the ground.
Flatter one around middle, worked towards mid on.

SIX! Launched it! After the second ball, long off was brought in and Holder decides to go after this loopy delivery. Gets his front foot out of the way and lofts it neatly over the long off boundary for a biggie all the way. Hold on, he was catching his shoulder in the previous over, where is the pain?
Quicker one outside off, Jason lets it pass.
Tossed up outside off, Holder presses forward in defense.

Quick single! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Holder taps it towards the leg side and calls for the single. Yasir from mid-wicket is a bit late to react as the batsmen make it through easily in the end.

Jason Holder appears to be having some discomfort with his left shoulder, probably from the blow he received earlier in Mohammad Amir's over. The physio jogs out with his handy magic spray and gets down to work.
Holder presses forward to this full ball and defends it down. He calls the physio straightaway after blocking one out.
Length ball outside off, it stays low, really low, just like my energy at the moment. Holder decides to not go after it.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, flicked towards square leg as the fielder dives to his right to stop it. A quick run taken.
Angles in a length ball on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Abbas comes from over the wicket and starts the spell with a bouncer, Dowrich ducks under it.
In the air... safe! Tossed up ball around off, Holder makes room and tries to drive it away from the body. Gets an outside edge which falls short of the point fielder.
Dipping in around middle, pushed towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Clubbed away, says Rameez Raja on air. Short and around leg, Dowrich rocks back, picks up the length and smacks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Skids through the surface and raps Dowrich on the pads.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside leg, negative line from Yasir. Dowrich pads it away.
Oh there's a nice rainbow overhead. Looks beautiful. The dark clouds are hovering over but no to worry, folks. We will be packing our bags by the time they burst...
Outside off, left alone by Holder.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
Short ball on middle and leg, Holder once again ducks.
Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Jason ducks under it.
Prods forward to this full ball and defends it down gently.
Sprays it fuller on off, Holder pushes it towards the cover region.
Tries to bowl around the legs, Dowrich is happy to defend it down.
A long hop from the leggie, Shane misses out. He looks to pull but mistimes it towards mid on.
Way down the leg side, Dowrich gets across and works it towards fine leg. Good work in the deep and they take two more.
Loopy ball outside leg, Dowrich moves inside the line to leave it alone.
Babar Azam at silly point has been hit hard on the left forearm on the previous delivery. The physio is out and has the magic spray with him. Sprays some and Babar Azam is ready to get back to work.

Ouch! That must have hurt! A short ball around off, Dowrich rocks back to cut it away. He does so but on its way it hits Babar Azam on the forearm at silly point. He looks in agony as it came like a rocket to him.

200 on the board for West Indies! And the ever enthusiastic crowd cheer for it! Good to see them dancing and having a jolly time out there. Yasir comes from around the wicket and lands it around leg, it turns away as Dowrich bashes it through covers for a couple.
Goes over the wicket for the last ball of the over, bangs in a short ball, angling down leg. No worries for Holder, he simply ducks.
Bangs in a short ball on leg, Holder bends his back to keep Sarfraz busy.
Length ball, coming back in, Jason blocks it down.
Pitches it up on off, Holder once again lets it be.
Angles it across the Windies skipper who doesn't even look at it.
Keeps it full on off, Holder jams it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Very full on off, Jason takes a long stride forward and eases it down to long off. Gets to the other end.
Turns it away from a length, with some bounce as Shane cuts it through covers for a single.
Drifting in from around off, defended gently off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, Shane comes forward to defend it down.
Attempts the googly, but it goes straight after pitching, Dowrich didn't pick it at all and almost slices it in front of the off pole.
Once again bowls a bouncer, this time it has good pace on it, Holder sits under it.
Slower loopy bounce on middle and leg, Holder is late to pick it up. Tries to take evasive action at the last moment and as a result the ball goes off the left shoulder towards the keeper's left.
Hurls it on a good length on off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller and angling on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, Jason defends it off the back foot.
The floodlights have been switched on.
Fuller and wide outside off, Holder lifts his bat to let it be.
Gives it a lot of flight and serves it just outside off, Dowrich drives it towards the cover fielder.
Tossed up around middle and leg, kept out off the front foot.
Flatter through the air around middle, Shane defends it off the back foot.
Turning away from a length outside off, Dowrich doesn't play at it.
Keeps it very full outside off, Holder leans across and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Leg break around middle and leg, spinning away as Holder covers the sticks and punches it back down the wicket.
Shortish and coming back in with the angle, Dowrich hops and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Serves a cutter, it's on a length, Dowrich has a tame push inside the line and is beaten all ends up.
Overpitches it outside off, Dowrich transfers his weight on the front foot to get it past Misbah at covers. A brace taken.
Switches the angle, goes around the wicket and bowls it on a back of a length outside off, a back foot punch towards covers where Misbah dives forward to take it on the bounce.
Sprays it very full outside off, Shane reaches out to that one and drives it a bit square of the wicket on the off side for two.
Comes from over the wicket and hurls across a length ball, nipping back in from off, Dowrich stays put to keep it out with a solid back foot defense.
Mohammad Amir is back on to bowl.
The news from the West Indies' official twitter account is that Roston Chase is not off the ground. He is being treated by the medical staff there itself on the bruise received on his right hand.
Drinks are on the field!
Full around middle and leg, nudged away on the leg side. A maiden in the comeback spell.
Once again gives it a nice flight and beats Holder on the poke. Good bowling from the leggie.
Ripppa! Tosses it up near the eye line, draws the West Indies skipper forward, gets the ball to turn away and almost take the outside edge.
Floats it up around off, defended into the ground.
Tries to bowl the top spinner, Holder rocks back and punches it towards square leg where the fielder puts in a dive to stop some runs.
Tossed up outside off, blocked gently off the front foot.
Stays behind the line and defends it with a straight blade.
Bangs in a short ball, angling down leg, easily ducked under it.
Keeps it pretty full, outside off, Dowrich lunges forward and drives it towards mid off.
Serves a harmless length ball outside off, Shane doesn't play at it.
Once again on a fuller length outside off, pushed off the front foot toward covers.
Pitches it up outside off, driven towards mid off.
Short and wide outside off, cut away through cover-point by Dowrich to retain strike.
Spin and bounce for Yasir Shah. He floats it on middle, turns away and rips off the surface too. Almost takes the outside edge of Dowrich's bat but he fortunately withdraws it at the last second.
Full toss on middle, Jason whips it to the right of mid on and takes a run.
Quite full again, this time it's driven to Misbah at short extra cover.
A little too full on off, Holder strides ahead and pushes it in front of cover-point.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Jason Holder leans ahead and pushes it square on the off side.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dowrich closes the bat face and flicks it to the mid-wicket area for no run.
Angling down leg, Shane looks to flick it down fine but fails to do so.
Back of a length on off, Holder stays back, rides the bounce and works it to square leg for a single.
Jason Holder is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Gone this time! The previous appeal didn't work, but this is a much better delivery and Vishaul Singh is out of here. Abbas from around the wicket bowls a beautiful length delivery around off, it's shaping back in sharply and catches Vishaul right in front of the stumps on the pads. The finger goes up this time and the southpaw, after having a chat with his partner reviews it. The third umpire has a look and the replays show that the southpaw has no chance of being safe. Timely strike for the visitors.
Vishaul Singh has been adjudged lbw. He has decided to review the decision. He looks to be in trouble though, seems more of a desperate review.
Appeal for an lbw, shut down. Clearly so, it was always going down. Shaping in around leg, hits the pads as he looks to flick.
Wicket-to-wicket line, Shane walks across and works it to the mid-wicket region.
Length delivery which skids off the pitch a bit, around off, comes to Dowrich a bit quicker than expected. He still manages to chop it past Yasir Shah at point and gets a couple of runs for it.
FOUR BYES! Amir with a crazy bouncer, takes off as soon as it hits the deck and it's angling down leg. Goes past the diving keeper and away to the fine leg fence. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Slightly ahead of a length, around off, Dowrich comes half-forward to keep it out.
Into the body on a length, worked away to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Mohammad Amir, from around the wicket, hits the deck hard and bangs in a short of a length delivery. Gets it to angle in on off as Shane Dowrich defends it off his back foot.
Vishaul Singh chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Hurled outside off, played to point.
Lands this on a good length, some width on offer as Vishaul looks to flay it through the off side. Misses and it's through to the keeper.
Abbas has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, angles in a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Bit straighter in line, it's flicked to mid-wicket by Singh.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Vishaul Singh slashes at this but fails to make any sort of connection.
Shaping away from outside off, Shane Dowrich has nothing to do with that one.
Gets behind the line of this one better and blocks it out.

ALMOST A WICKET! Mohammad Amir strikes almost immediately. Shane Dowrich is a lucky guy. An excellent length delivery around off and it's swinging back in, Dowrich hangs his bat out in front of his body and gets a healthy edge. It flies behind to Younis Khan at second slip who dives low to his left. Just falls short of him though.

Roston Chase seems to be in some discomfort as he got a beating on his right hand on the previous ball. The physio is out to assist him. Magic spray is applied on his right hand. He's the key man for the hosts and they would be hoping no serious damage has been done. A bit of halt in play. Not a good news for the Windies, Roston Chase is walking off the field - Retired hurt! Shane Dowrich is the new man in replacing him...
Back of a length on the body, Roston Chase swivels and goes for the pull. Misses and gets hit on the right arm. He's instantly down on the ground and signals for medical attention.
Angling across on a good length, Chase stands his ground and meets it with a straight bat.
Amir comes from wide of the crease and slants it across the right-hander, it's kept out from within the crease down on the turf.
On the pads, Roston whips it along the ground to fine leg for a single.
Another bouncer, but this one is at a legitimate height, Chase ducks and evades.
Wide! It's banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length close to the off stump, defended off the back foot.
Good line, it's just around the off pole, Chase covers the line and leaves it alone.
Nice shape away from Abbas, good line too, it's moving away from around off, Chase leaves it alone. Abbas needs to do this more consistently, maintain the pressure on the batsman doing that.
Drinks!
Coming in on middle and leg, Singh works it to the mid-wicket fielder.
On the fuller side of things, it's driven off the middle but straight to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and darted on off, Vishaul Singh keeps bat and pad close together and defends it out.
On the hips, clipped away in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut away through cover-point for a single.
Mohammad Amir will be the one to share the new ball with Abbas.

FOUR! That was close. Back of a length around off, Chase looks to cut but it's too close to his body. Ends up getting an inside edge which goes past the off pole and through the left of the diving keeper for a boundary. Unfortunate for Abbas there, wasn't a bad ball at all.
Bit straight in line, flicked to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Back of a length outside off, easily left alone.

FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Chase cuts it past point. It has enough legs to go all the way to the boundary line. The Pakistan bowlers will have to be careful with their lines. Anything loose and it'll be punished.
Jagging back in on middle and leg, tucked in front of mid-wicket.
Length delivery around the off stick, Chase with a straight blade ensures it's kept out solidly.
And, Mohammad Abbas will be the one to take the new cherry.
The second new ball is available and it's immediately taken by Misbah-ul-Haq. Wasting no time here.
3rd Test fifty for Roston Chase!

Fifty for Chase! Gutsy knock from him till now, he's done well to hang in there. Clears his front leg, pushes it to mid off and takes off. Beats the throw at the bowler's end and completes the run. Raises his bat to the teammates in the dressing room and goes back to get on with the job. Well played, lad.
Loopy full ball on leg, gets his front leg out of the way and pushes it back to Yasir.
Short into the body, Vishaul pulls it away through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Leg break on a full length, around off, prods forward and pushes it out.
Kicking off the surface and going down leg, left alone by the left-hander.

Almost a catch! Ooohh.. That was a close one. Yasir loops it on a driving length, Vishaul Singh comes down the track and flicks it towards Babar Azam at short leg. He dives to his right, sticks his hand out but just can't get to it. Was real close.
Hasan Ali is off the field. Probably just a precautionary measure.
Angles it across on a fuller length, Roston Chase pushes it away from his body in front of covers. No real footwork in playing that, dot ball.
Hasan Ali keeps it on the leg stump line, once more it's clipped to the mid-wicket area.
Full ball on the pads, it's flicked away to mid-wicket once more.
Full toss on off, Roston whips it to mid-wicket. Didn't time it well at all as it bounces away to the fielder positioned there.
Seems Hasan Ali has a minor cramp in his left calf. The physio is out to take a look. Doesn't look like it's anything too serious, so he should be okay to continue.
Switches the angle and comes around the wicket, bangs it in short and it's just down leg, Chase looks to pull but the ball rises on him too quickly.
Short of a good length pounded outside off, Roston drops his wrists and lets the ball go past him.
Once again it's turning down leg, this time Vishaul Singh leaves it alone.
Spinning down leg, Singh looks to glance it fine. It goes off the thigh pad and into the hands of the fielder at leg slip. Nothing from the umpire.
Some venomous turn for the leggie, it kicks off the wicket again, Chase is back as he slaps it square towards point for a single.
Turning away, on middle and leg, Chase presses forward and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Turn and bounce for Yasir Shah. He continues from around the wicket, it shoots off the surface and spins it, Singh rocks back and pulls it over leg slip. Just a single on this occasion.

He comes from around the wicket and it spins away towards off, Roston Chase goes back and deals with this well as there's extra bounce on it. Cuts it through the covers and will pick up three runs for it. He moves on to 48.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack.
Places himself perfectly behind the line and defends it down on the turf ahead.
Coming in on middle and leg, defended on the leg side. No run taken.

Not out! Hasan Ali has overstepped and that is where everything stops, no need to check any further. Unsuccessful review for Pakistan. Hasan Ali bowled a cutter on off, went off the pads behind on the off side. Not exactly sure what happened there, so can't say any further.
An lbw appeal against Vishaul Singh is reviewed by Pakistan.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, pushes in front of silly point where the fielder dives to his right and stops it.
Cleverly takes the pace off this, Vishaul is early into the shot. The ball goes off the top half and falls down. That's why that silly point is in place, precisely for this purpose.
Bit ahead of a length, well outside off, cut away by the southpaw straight to the point fielder.
A silly point comes in place...
From around the wicket, it's angling in from around off, Singh off his back foot deals with it comfortably.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Stays within his crease and blocks it out.
Hops back, stands tall and pushes it on the off side.
Short, turning and going down leg, Vishaul pulls it behind square on the leg side. Two more runs for him.
Full toss from Azhar Ali, Vishaul Singh comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket. Gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Flat ball darted outside off, Roston Chase punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Vishaul Singh has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
No much movement on this occasion, the ball holds its line as the batsman taps it down on the track.
Spears it fuller in length, just outside off, Singh pushes it back down the track solidly.
Full and into the pads, from around the wicket, clipped to the square leg area for a quick one.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire as Roston Chase sways away from the line.
Shortens the length on this a bit, Chase hangs back and meets it with a straight bat.
Serves a length delivery outside off, Chase from within his crease taps it away in front of cover-point. No run taken.
Stays in his crease and wrists it away on the leg side.
Darts it quicker on middle and off, skids off the deck and keeps low as well, Vishaul Singh goes back and manages to bring his bat down in time to keep it out.
Comes forward and works it through mid-wicket for nothing.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drops it on a fullish length, Singh blocks it out off the front foot.
Short and turning away from around off, Chase goes back and cuts it through to sweeper cover for a single.
Azhar Ali to continue from the other end.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Singh ducks under it.
Shortish outside off, defended nicely off the back foot.
No ball! Fuller and angling in on off, Vishaul flicks it towards the leg side. Ali oversteps and that will be a no ball.
Full toss, dipping in, Singh clips it to short mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery, rising off the deck, Chase pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller once again, angling in, Chase prods forward in defense.
Fuller in length and just outside off, Chase stands tall to keep it out.

We are back for the evening session. Will we see the hosts scoring runs freely or will the story remain same even in this session? Let's wait and find out. Vishaul Singh will join Roston Chase out in the middle. Hasan Ali to start proceedings first up. Let's play...
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

A blockathon session which is shared by both sides was what I had prepared to write in my mind until the last ball was bowled! West Indies will be more happy as they have not let Pakistan chip away at the wickets, while the visitors will be happy about the fact that they didn't let the hosts score freely. A wicket just at the stroke of tea would have lifted Misbah and his men. Just 55 runs have been scored but got to give it to Chase and Hope for being rock solid. They have countered Yasir Shah's web, Mohammad Amir and Hasan Ali's reverse and nothing seemed to have bothered them. With the pitch having no demons on it, a long day at the office beckons Pakistan, provided West Indies don't do anything silly. Join us in a bit for the final session of the day...

OUT! Azhar Ali strikes just at the stroke of tea! We saw a wicket falling at lunch and the same has happened now. All the hard work once again sold down the river. Slower through the air around off, Shai Hope makes room to go inside out but ends up playing it a bit early. Chips it straight to Misbah-ul-Haq at short cover who takes a good low catch. It's his 50th Test catch as well! Azhar Ali is up and running! Pakistan get the breakthrough! TEA ON DAY 3!

50-run stand between Hope and Chase!

Quicker one outside off, Hope blocks it down.

It would have been an even session but the wicket on the last delivery before lunch as titled it in Pakistan's favour. Yasir Shah ran through the Windies' top order as he took out all three of them. He made full use of the turn on offer and gave his team a slim advantage going into the break. Kraigg Brathwaite was the last one to depart, he was playing really well but was unfortunate to face a ripper from the leggie. A big afternoon session lies in front of the hosts. The middle order has a big task on their hands. Join us in a bit for the action.

They appeal and the umpire after taking his time raises his finger. Yasir is pumped up and with that, IT'S LUNCH ON DAY 3!

On a length and it holds its line, Hetmyer pokes it with soft hands and gets it past gully. They take two.
Gets across and defends it into the ground.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Shot! Loopy delivery on the rough outside off, Hetmyer gets down and sweeps it off the middle of the bat through square leg. It was in the air for a while but no damage done. The ball goes through and Shimron gets a boundary.
In the air... safe! Fuller around middle, Kraigg comes down the track to go big but miscues it over a leaping mid-wicket fielder for three.
Short and around off, it turns away, punched off the back foot towards cover-point.
Loopy leg break around middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Hurls it on a length and it nips back in a bit as Hetmyer pokes inside the line only to get beaten.
Fuller in length and outside off, Hetmyer mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Driven towards mid off for nothing.
No ball! Back of a length delivery from around off, kept out off the back foot. No ball signalled though as Hasan Ali overstepped his line.
Back to over the wicket, it's coming back in on middle and leg, Brathwaite works it on the leg side for a single.
Starts off from around the wicket, it's full and angling into the pads, Hetmyer leans ahead and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shimron Hetmyer will walk into the middle next at No.3.

OUT! Yasir Shah gets the breakthrough! Kieran Powell looking to attack the leggie again, but falls prey to him this time. Gives the charge again and slogs this over mid-wicket. Doesn't have the distance on this and it presents an opportunity to Azhar Ali in the deep. He runs to his right and dives to take an excellent catch. Pakistan rejoice, the gritty opening stand is broken.

Was there an edge? Apparently not as the umpire doesn't signal anything. Tossed up outside off, Powell plants his front foot across to defend off the front foot but the ball lobs off something and goes behind to first slip, where the catch is taken. Appeal for a catch but the umpire remains unmoved. Probably pad, then.
Sharp turn into the batsman, Powell goes back to play but is hit on the thigh pad.
Loops it up back of a driving length, outside off, Powell dances down the track and whips it towards wide mid on.
FOUR! That's an excellent shot. Attacks Yasir Shah as he kneels down and sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary. Good intent shown, probably the best way to play against the leggie.
From around the wicket, a tossed up leg spinner outside off, spins off the rough and takes the inner half of the bat as Powell leans ahead.
Yasir Shah has a change of ends this time.
Shaping back in on middle and off, off the inner half it's worked to mid-wicket.
Extremely full and swinging back in on off, Brathwaite leans ahead and drives it to mid off.
Pitched right up there again, it's driven to mid on.
Fuller ball attacking the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, Brathwaite hangs inside his crease and meets it with a straight bat.
Fuller in length and a hint of reverse for Ali, Brathwaite drives it towards mid on.
Hasan Ali is into the attack now.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Powell stays put and keeps it out.
Touch short and around leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through extra cover for a single.
Back of a length, nipping back in a shade from outside off, Kieran goes back and dabs it with an angled bat towards point.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, it kicks off the deck, Powell ducks under the bumper.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven on the bounce to short cover.
Drinks!
Fuller around leg, it stays really low. Kraigg somehow manages to get his bat down in time.
Around leg, Kraigg crouches low to turn it towards the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy delivery around leg, Brathwaite buries it into the ground.
Takes a long stride forward and keeps it out.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended into the ground.
Fuller and angling on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
Beaten! Slants it away outside off, Powell leans across to poke at it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
KP defends it from within the crease.
Fuller outside off, Powell has got nothing to do with that one.
Gets behind the line and defends it down gently.
Good length delivery on middle, Powell keeps it out off the front foot.
Floats it up outside off, Kraigg presses forward and drives it towards the off side.
Comes down the track and drives it towards the man at mid off for a quick single.
Loops it up outside off, turning in a bit, Powell prods forward in defense.
Serves it a bit wide outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Quicker through the air around off, Brathwaite drives it towards the cover fielder.
Tossed up outside off, pushed back to the leggie.
On a length and outside off, Kieran gets inside the line to leave it alone.
A sharp bouncer on middle and leg, Powell ducks to evade it.
Angles in a length delivery on middle and leg, Powell misses his flick and is hit on the thigh pad.
Once again serves it in the channel outside off, Powell lifts his bat to let it be.
Slants it across the southpaw, Powell shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Mohammad Abbas has a change of ends.
Turning in from around off, Powell off his back foot punches it to point for a single.
Stays back and keeps it out on the off side off the back foot.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
It's fuller again, outside off, Brathwaite comes down the track and digs it out back in the direction of the bowler.
Bowls it right up there, it's kept out in front of mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Yasir Shah is into the attack now.
Full outside off and the batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his stumps.
A great follow-up delivery, yorker from Amir. Brathwaite digs it out. Good ball there by Amir.
A slower one by Amir on a length on off stump. Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Short ball but outside off stump and Brathwaite lets the ball go.
Driven to mid on. Full ball on middle and leg and it's driven back down the ground.
On a length. Coming in with the angle. the batsman defends it on the front foot.
Litttle movement off the deck once more, Abbas makes it go away from Kieran Powell, it's kept out from within the crease.
Fuller length ball swinging away, off the outer half Powell pushes it to cover-point.
On a good length, seaming away off the wicket from around off, Kieran Powell ensures he stays back and taps it down square on the off side.
One more easy leave. It's well outside off, no shot offered as it's taken by the keeper.
Comes from around the wicket this time, bangs it on a short of a length but it's way outside off, easy leave for Kieran.
Angles it across the southpaw, he covers the line well and shoulders his arms to it.
Very good there by Amir. Using the angle, the ball comes in sharply and the batsman decides to leave the ball. A good leave there.
Hits a good length but outside off stump, the batsman lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Amir comes round the wicket. Bowls it outside off and the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Bowls it a little short of a length and the batsman defends it of the back foot this time.
Hits the good length and is defended by the batsman off the front foot.
Amir bowls it full, gets the ball to move away. Powell opens the face of the bat and drives it between gully and point for a run.
On a length on off stump, stays on the back foot and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Short of a good length outside off, nicely punched off the back foot but straight to point.
Once again the line is well wide outside off, Brathwaite isn't interested to play at those.
Length ball outside off, a bit wide to make the batsman play.
A bit of nip back into the batsman from a length outside off, watchfully left by Kraigg.
On a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Drifting on the pads, worked away in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Pitched up outside off, moves forward and blocks it towards mid off.

LAZY STUFF! Fullish and outside off, Brathwaite times the push well through the vacant mid off region. The batsmen take the second run almost as an afterthought and it could have been close for the southpaw with a better throw at the bowler's end.
Angling across the right-hander, Brathwaite stands tall and blocks firmly to cover.
On a length around off, seaming away a bit as Brathwaite looks to punch off the back foot. Gets it off the bottom half on the bounce to the bowler.
Dug in short around middle, well-directed bumper and Brathwaite just about manages to sway away.
FOUR! First boundary of the day! Full and on the pads, Powell flicks this ever so well through the mid-wicket region. Gets it across the rope and ends the over with a boundary.
Outside off on a good length, no trouble for the batsman to leave it alone.

Full and moving away, just around the off pole, Powell just checks his drive as he places this past backward point off the outer half. The fielder there chases it down and keeps the batsmen to two runs.
Back of a length delivery on off, not giving much room to Kieran Powell to free his arms, he can only stay back and keep it down on the track ahead.
Angles across a length delivery, outside off, another one comfortably left alone.
Quite wide outside off, going further away from the southpaw, he raises his bat and lets it be.
Good run. Powell waits for the ball to come to him and drops it in front of covers. Hares across and completes the run with ease. Smartly done.
On the fifth stump line, straightening up after hitting the deck, Kieran Powell covers the line well and shoulders his arms to it.
Going away from the batsman, pitched on a length, left alone.
Excellent seam position, hurled on a length in the off stump channel, Powell leans ahead a touch and defends it down with soft hands.

Loud scream from Amir for a leg before, turned down though. Dangerous shot to play from Brathwaite, especially when the ball is still moving about a bit. He walks across to this length ball on leg, swinging down leg slightly and it catches Kraigg on the pads who looks to flick. Was missing the stumps this time, but the right-hander has to be careful here. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls away on the leg side.
Slants across a length delivery around off, Brathwaite stands his ground and meets it with a straight blade.
Mohammad Amir will bowl from the other end.
Attacking the stump on a full length, driven straight back to mid on for nothing.
Amazing shape from Mohammad Abbas. Hits the line well, around the off pole, moving away and beats the outside edge as Kieran Powell hangs his bat out to it.
Nicely played by Powell, just about the timing on that. Walks across to this length ball and meets it with the full face. Works it through backward square leg and takes two more.
Good length delivery shaping back in, on middle and off, kept out from within the crease.

Full and swinging in a bit, straight in line and this allows Powell to work it through the leg side. Gets it through mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs for doing so. First runs of the day for Powell and West Indies.
A full ball outside off to start off with, Powell plants his front foot forward and drives it to mid off.

We're ready to get things going on Day 3. Kraigg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell take their place in the middle with the Pakistan team spreading out across the field. The left-hander will take strike with Mohammad Abbas bowling at him first up. Three slips and a gully in place.

A gruelling day awaits Jason Holder's men. The wicket is flat but a bit on the slower side and with a lot of turn on offer. The batsmen will have to apply themselves and be patient in their approach. If they can get their eye in, they'll be able to score runs more freely, as was shown by Pakistan in the first two days. There is rain forecast, but like yesterday, we hope it doesn't interrupt. Should be an intriguing day of Test cricket.

Welcome for the third day of this final Test between West Indies and Pakistan at Windsor Park. After having a rain-hit first day, Pakistan picked up the pace yesterday after the top order provided a good base. A late surge from Sarfraz Ahmed took the visitors to a score of 376. The hosts saw out the final overs of the day and negotiated the tight period well with Kraigg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell looking solid.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

After bowling out Pakistan for 376, West Indies have done well to see out the tricky period till the end of the day. Kriagg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell negotiated well to go unscathed, and that should give the Windies camp some relief after a long and tiring day. They have their task cut out though tomorrow as the pitch is turning and it'll be a hard day for them. Join us for all the action from Day 3. There will be an early start again, at 0930 local time. Till then, cheers!
Fuller on the stumps, Kraigg Brathwaite presses forward and drives it back to the bowler. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Pitches it right up there on off, Kraigg Brathwaite defends it with a straight blade.
Shorter outside off, moves away, an easy leave for the batsman.
Touch fuller on off, Brathwaite lunges forward to block it out.
Good length, coming back in on middle, Kraigg stays put to defend it down.
The debutant starts off with a half-volley on the pads, Powell shuffles a touch and flicks it through mid-wicket. Yasir Shah gives it a chase and keeps them down to three.
Hasan Ali to have a go with the ball now.
Takes a good stride forward and smothers it away on the off side.
Woah! Tosses it up outside off, it turns away with ultra bounce on it. Brathwaite goes after it and almost gets undone.
Flatter through the air and served outside off, Kraigg goes back and dabs it towards third man for a couple of runs.
Kraigg has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker one outside off, Kraigg punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Brathwaite lunges forward and keeps it out.
Fuller and tailing back in, the batsman offers a solid front foot defense.
Gets this one to move away from the southpaw, Powell dabs it with soft hands towards gully.
Short and it shoots off the surface, Powell is quick to duck under it.
Shorter and once again coming in on middle, Kieran defends it off the back foot.
Goes wide of the crease and angles this one on middle, Powell stays behind the line and defends it back to Amir.
Fuller and nipping back in, Powell keeps it out solidly.
It's gotten really dark out there. The floodlights have been turned down. But we cricket lovers shouldn't feel sad, as just 8 mins or so are left for the close of play...
Very full on the pads, worked through mid-wicket by Powell and he will keep strike.
Gives this one a bit more flight around off, Powell defends it down.
Quicker one around leg, Powell hangs back in defense.
Drifting in on middle, Powell defends it off the front foot gently.
Loops it up outside off, Kraigg lunges forward to defend but gets an outside edge which goes wide of first slip and picks up a single.
Starts off with a loopy leg break around middle and leg, it turns away as Brathwaite lunges forward to block it out.
Spin time as Yasir Shah is handed the cherry.
On a length bit it's a bit too wide outside off, Powell doesn't even look at it.
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a single.
The ball nips back in a touch from outside off, KB stays behind the line to counter it.
Hits the deck hard, extracts bounce but it doesn't surprise Kraigg. The batsman ducks under it.
Keeps it away from the right-hander, Kraigg defends it down gently.
Yasir Shah is seen warming up. Probably get a few overs in before end of day's play.
Slants it away from Brathwaite who lifts his bat to let it be.
Kieran lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Keeps it on the middle stump, Powell presses forward and defends it down on the pitch.
Fuller and sliding down leg, flicked through square leg for a single. Brathwaite opens his account.
Good length delivery on middle, defended off the front foot.
Bangs in a short ball, it rises off the deck. Kraigg moves inside the line and then shoulders his arms.
Shorter outside off, Brathwaite has got nothing to offer on this one.
On a length and swinging away, it doesn't make Powell go after it.
That's a brave leave! Amir goes wide of the crease and angles this one in. The ball nips back with a good amount of bounce as Powell shoulders his arms. Lovely delivery!
KP lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good length and it holds its line, Powell defends it off the front foot.
The sun is out but there is some drizzle in the air...
Fuller and swinging away, Powell lets it be.

Fuller and angling in on off, Powell drives it right under his eyes through covers. The ever fit, Misbah gives it a chase, slides and stops it. They take two but what fitness level boss. The cricketing world will miss your services sir!
Touch short and outside off, Brathwaite gets on top of the bounce to cut it. But finds Yasir again at cover-point.
Outside off, KB lunges forward and pushes it towards Yasir Shah at cover-point.
Nice carry! It's hurled on a length, shaping away off the deck, Brathwaite watches it till the last moment and then lets it pass.
Fuller and shaping away a touch, Kraigg prods forward in defense.
Pitches it up on off, Brathwaite comes forward to work it away but does so off the inner half towards square leg.
Good length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Places himself behind the line of the delivery and defends it down on the turf.
Good length delivery on off, Powell taps it in front of covers. Looks for the single which obviously wasn't on.
Bangs in a short ball, angling in on the body, Powell is happy to duck under it.
Comes in from a length outside off, Kieran walks across the sticks, covers it before shouldering his arms.
Keeps it in the channel outside off, Kieran defends it down gently.

Angles in a full length delivery, Powell gets across a touch and flicks it through backward square leg. The fine leg fielder mops it up to keep them down to two. That's a risky shot to play against Amir when the ball is swinging.
Back of a length outside off, a solid back foot defense on offer.
Good length, nipping in a bit, Powell tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. West Indies are away.
Powell stays behind the line to defend it down.

What a delivery! A loud shout for an LBW! Pitches it up on off and this one jags back in sharply to ping Powell on the pads. Abbas appeals but the umpire turns it down. Misbah asks Sarfraz and the Pakistan keeper says he heard two noises. Replays show that Sarfraz is bang on. Clear inside edge which saves Powell.
Fuller in length and outside off, Powell defends it off the front foot.
Good length delivery on off, Powell lifts his bat to let that go.
Mohammad Abbas to share the new ball from the other end!
Once again Amir tries to keep it full, in search for some swing. Brathwaite hangs back to keep it out. Excellent start from Amir, a maiden!
Fullish on off, KB offers a solid front foot defense.
Back of a length delivery, but it's going down leg. Kraigg stays inside the line to leave it for Ahmed.
Fuller and just around the off stump line, Brathwaite pushes it towards covers.
Fuller and it's outside off, Kraigg blocks it solidly off the front foot.
Good ball! Amir comes from over the wicket and slants it on a length outside off, Brathwaite looks to poke inside the line but the ball keeps moving away and just about takes the outside edge.
